name: Experimental Methods in Biology
description: Lecture: introduction to biomolecules and cells; electrophoresis, DNA fingerprinting and EMSA; basics of microscopy; optical spectroscopy – Raman, IR, fluorescence, UV-VIS; FCS; electron microscopy; NMR; circular dichroism; force spectroscopy – AFM, optical tweezers, magnetic tweezers; surface plasmon resonance, mass spectrometry, chromatography, xray crystallography, flow-cytometry, recent advances in biophysical techniques. Laboratory: separation of nucleic acid and proteins on agarose and polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis, respectively; difference between native and SDS-PAGE; Ni-NTA chromatography; cell mobility under microscope; protein purity and secondary structure assessment using CD spectroscopy; crystal formation and visualization of a protein using x-ray crystallography; Raman spectroscopy.
